gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-mono: Stencilia strikes a structural pose, with generous gaps where its curves end and a tight space under the ascenders. Noto Sans Mono follows in sturdy, well-spaced letters.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro packs its words dense and tall through the middle, with wide entrances into each letter. Stencilia is the one built to stand out and make a statement, while Noto Sans Mro simply gets on with the text.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-multan: Noto Sans Multani reads lofty and modern, its e gaping at the terminal. Stencilia is the one that grabs attention with structural, striking shapes, while the plain sans body quietly handles the actual reading.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-myanma: Noto Sans Myanmar lays down a thick, heavy-looking band of text, its c opening broad and welcoming. Noto Sans Myanmar would carry a long page steadily, while Stencilia above it stays striking and structural.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-nabata: Stencilia brings structural, striking display letters with spacious gaps at the curve ends. Beneath it, Noto Sans Nabataean stands almost cap-tall, its s curves wide open, so the heading and text feel like one confident voice.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-nag-mu: Striking, with a structural edge, comes first from Stencilia. Noto Sans Nag Mundari follows with c and s shapes that look half unwrapped and lowercase rivaling the capitals, so a long passage feels open and tall.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-nandin: Big, friendly lowercase meets a structural headline. And Noto Sans Nandinagari keeps its openings generous at every weight, with short ascenders, which gives it an approachable quality that Stencilia's striking display letters lean against nicely.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-newa: Stencilia is structural and striking, with spacious curve terminals. Its strongest quality is the way Noto Sans Newa answers it, a plain sans whose lowercase e opens its mouth clearly and whose bowls stand tall.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu holds its terminals far from the stroke body and lifts a towering x-height above the baseline. Beneath Stencilia's structural display letters, it gives the page a striking top and a modern, spacious text.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Tall, bold-looking text under a structural heading. Noto Sans Ogham brings wide gaps in the e and towering lowercase bodies, and that sturdy, clean sans-serif presence is what makes Stencilia's striking display letters feel anchored.
